Times Higher Education ranked the Lagos State University as the second best university in Nigeria on 2 September 2020, and was the only state university included in the rankings for 2022.

✓ Lagos State University.question: Times Higher Education ranked the Lagos State University as the second best university in Nigeria on _____ September 2020, and was the only state university included in the rankings for 2022
✓ Lagos State University.fact: LASU was ranked among the top 600 universities in the world by the Times Higher Education World University Rankings for 2020. On 23 June 2021, LASU emerged as the best young university in Nigeria having been below the age of 50 years to be added.
